answer: Follow the money to its last stop. Each agent must bind one cash-out address, frozen for ninety days, and the ledger traces where withdrawals finally land. When several identities' earnings drain into the same onyx-black vault, however many hops away, they are merged into one account and the copies' pending rewards are forfeited. A sybil farm can scatter keys across the tundra of the network, but on the horizon its profits must converge somewhere, and that convergence is what gets caught.
